manifest.comparison: Same first NIM response shared between single-pass and conditional arms; no oracle supplied to models.

workflow_versions.nim_conditional: shared extraction + at most one repair + advisory review if blocked

limits: Synthetic templates shared across group-disjoint splits; not a template-generalization test.
Narrative cases deliberately measure the current evidence verifier's coverage limit.
No foundation model training is performed; train split reserved for future work.
Language phrasing requires independent bilingual validation before publication.

rules.scope: Seeded synthetic, group-disjoint benchmark; descriptive results only.

nim_single_pass.scope: Seeded synthetic, group-disjoint benchmark; descriptive results only.

nim_conditional.scope: Seeded synthetic, group-disjoint benchmark; descriptive results only.

paired_comparison.caution: Few synthetic groups; descriptive resampling interval, not evidence of real-world significance.

stress_test.type: deterministic injected-fault ablation, NOT observed NIM hallucination rate
stress_test.unchecked_arm: Simulation of copying proposals directly; no publication artifacts are created.

interpretation: Arm costs are logical standalone costs. Physical totals count shared first requests once. Tokens on timed-out calls may be unreported; no monetary price is assumed.
